mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative equity valuations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals manufacturing contraction that precedes reduced corporate output, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of 20-day periods when INDPRO declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly additions) indicates robust economic conditions that support corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPI inflation rate above 0.25% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.25% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI inflation and federal funds rate signal active monetary tightening, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 60-day returns with a Rank IC below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Negative quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 decline from prior quarter) signals economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of 60-day periods when GDPC1 declines from prior quarter (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
